svg.title: Terminal: whoami — Carlos Franco
svg.desc: An animated terminal. whoami: Carlos Franco, software engineer in training at FIAP, Sao Paulo. career.log: 10 years in luxury hospitality (bartender, head bartender, head of bar); 2024 founded Vica Experiencias, an events and bar brand; 2026 designed a cocktail menu awarded Best Drinks Menu; now building AI products and full-stack software. ./hire: available for internships and junior roles.
